# Cracktab

> Cracktab is a Shopify agency with offices in Canton, Ohio (US) and Dhaka (Bangladesh). It designs and builds Shopify stores, develops custom Shopify apps, migrates stores to Shopify, and grows existing stores as a Shopify CRO agency through conversion rate optimization (CRO), ecommerce management and SEO. It has worked on 170+ Shopify stores and also publishes its own apps on the Shopify App Store.

Contact: +1 (234) 901-2506 · https://cracktab.com/contact · Book a call: https://calendly.com/cracktab2025/30min

## Services

- [Shopify CRO Services and Ecommerce Management](https://cracktab.com/services/ecommerce-growth-cro): CRO audits, A/B tests, design and code fixes, speed, SEO, email and day-to-day store management
- [Shopify Development](https://cracktab.com/services/shopify-development): custom Shopify and Shopify Plus builds, redesigns and migrations
- [Shopify Theme & App Development](https://cracktab.com/services/shopify-app-development): custom theme sections, bundle and gift builders, private and public apps, integrations
- [How we do CRO](https://cracktab.com/how-we-work): the seven-step monthly process

## Shopify apps by Cracktab

- [Cracktab AI SEO](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps/ai-seo): free SEO app: SEO checklist, bulk meta descriptions, image compression, alt text and AI blog posts
- [Conversion Rate Optimizer](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps/conversion-rate-optimizer): free app with 18 no-code conversion widgets (upsells, countdown timers, stock indicators, trust blocks) and clicks tracked per widget
- [Widgetly Reviews](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps/widgetly-reviews): free photo reviews and product Q&A, with AI review import from a CSV
- [Custom Diamond Ring Builder](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps/custom-diamond-ring-builder): lets shoppers build a ring step by step (setting, diamond, metal, size)
- [All apps](https://cracktab.com/shopify-apps)
